about.title: A CPA office on FM 2100, helping the community one client at a time.
text: Hope E. Hartman attended school at the University of Houston, C.T. Bauer School of Business. There she earned her Bachelor degree in Accounting with a minor in Oil & Gas Accounting. She then went on to complete her Masters of Science in Accountancy and Taxation at the same university. She has over 17 years plus of experience in both the public and private sectors.
The office is at 20111 FM 2100 Suite 102 in Crosby, and we are actively seeking new clients in the Crosby, Huffman, Humble and Atascocita, Texas area.

team.name: Hope E. Hartman, CPA

Bauer School of Business, where she earned her Bachelor degree in Accounting with a minor in Oil & Gas Accounting, then completed her Masters of Science in Accountancy and Taxation at the same university. She has over 17 years plus of experience in both the public and private sectors, 14 years plus of it in oil and gas accounting, and is listed with QuickBooks as a ProAdvisor.

team.name: Mary Ann Wymore, CPA
team.bio: MaryAnn graduated from Texas A&M University, College Station, where she earned her bachelors in Accounting and her Masters in Business Administration. MaryAnn has been a business owner herself, and has extensive experience in operations, implementation, construction, bonding, and other key areas of accounting and taxation.

team.name: Jennifer Wolf
team.bio: Jennifer has worked for our office for a couple of years now. Previously she worked for a private engineering firm, heading the documentation control center. She is intelligent, thorough, and a great asset to our team.
